* **October 2026 ($100 total):**

  * Phone: 2,300 minutes. This is 1,300 minutes over the 1,000 free minutes allowance, resulting in two started 1,000-minute blocks ($20 charge) (Source: Mobile_Provider_Billing_Guide.md § 3).
